text:
sarah_m: Quick thread to hand off postmortem follow-ups from the GPU/autoscale incident. Need clear owners, short-term mitigations, and a decision timeline. Keep replies terse.

leo_ops: I'll own scheduler changes and the reserved headroom knob. Plan: prototype kube-scheduler config that prefers preempting batch jobs and create infra ticket for reserved_pool_percent. ETA: PR by Wed.

anya: I'll take runbook & postmortem edits. Adding recurrence table + explicit commands to enable/disable pre-warm pools and soft-throttles. Draft PR by Tue AM.

olivia_pm: I'll own monitoring and escalation criteria. Request: add "alloc_failure_rate" and "scale_loop_retries" metrics and a lead alert when alloc_failure_rate > 0.5% for 2m. Blocking any threshold rollout until alerts exist. ETA: alert defs by Tue EOD.

mark_t: I'll run the simulator experiments. Two configs: baseline and conservative (scale-up earlier, shorter cooldown). Will report p50/p95/p99, scale events, and cost delta. ETA: 72h.

rachel_d: I'll draft the short-term product mitigation: per-tenant soft burst quotas (token buckets) + a throttling policy doc for SRE. Will include customer messaging snippet. ETA: tomorrow.

leo_ops: For scheduler prototype: add priorityClass "inference-high" and a reclaim rule to prioritize preemption of pods with label "batch=best-effort". I'll include a kube-scheduler config diff in the PR.

mark_t: Simulator command I'm replaying:
```
./simctl replay --trace traces/2026-07-spike.json --burst-mult 6 --cold-kv --out results.json
```

mark_t: I'll run additional runs with an enabled pre-warm pool (8 GPUs TTL=10m) and without to measure impact.

anya: Runbook addition: emergency steps -> 1) enable pre-warm pool: `infractl headroom set --percent 8` 2) enable soft-throttle for noisy tenant: `quotactl throttle --tenant $ID --rate 50%` 3) notify ops channel + escalate.

infra-bot: Reminder: infra maintenance scheduled Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC; avoid canary during that window.

olivia_pm: Canary gating checklist: simulator numbers OK, alerts present, runbook in place, rollback scripts ready. Blocker if any missing.

rachel_d: Short-term mitigation note: token buckets default 10s fill, burst size 5s. We'll tune after sims. Drafted message for customers explaining temporary throttles and expected timeline.

mark_t: Owner summary for ticket: mark_t -> sims & numbers (72h), leo_ops -> scheduler + reserved_pool PR (Wed), anya -> runbook + postmortem updates (Tue AM), olivia_pm -> alerts & escalation rules (Tue EOD), rachel_d -> product throttling policy + messaging (tomorrow).

sarah_m: Solid. We'll meet Thu 09:00 to review simulator outputs and decide whether to canary. If all green, canary window 4h at 3% traffic, auto-rollback on p99 regress >20% or alloc failure alerts. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
